name: Minor Energy Draught
description: Restores 25 Energy. The road does not walk itself.

name: Energy Draught
description: Restores 60 Energy. Brewed for those who refuse to stop.

name: Minor Stamina Draught
description: Restores 25 Stamina. Steadies the arm for one more strike.

name: Stamina Draught
description: Restores 60 Stamina. The long fight favours the prepared.

name: Minor Healing Poultice
description: Restores 25 Health. Crude, bitter, and enough.

name: Healing Poultice
description: Restores 60 Health. Closes what the raid opened.

name: Ancient's Restorative
description: Refills your Energy completely. Found, never sold.

name: Oathsteel Ingot
description: Steel quenched in a spoken oath. The forge remembers what was promised.

name: Vanguard Banner
description: Carried at the front until the front moved. Proof of a line that held.

name: Wyrm Scale
description: Prised from a raid boss that did not part with it willingly.

name: Causeway Ash
description: Grey, weightless, and everywhere on the Ashen Causeway. Smiths pack it around a quench because it takes heat without ever giving it back.

name: Hollow Marches Reed
description: Grows only where the ground is too wet to bury anything. The Marches are full of them.

name: Emberfall Slag
description: Run-off from a fire that burned in the Age of Dawn and has not entirely stopped. Warm at the core a thousand years after the fact.

name: Keepwall Mortar
description: Prised from a wall Malachar's masons raised in one night. Nobody has explained the speed.

name: Rime-Glass
description: Frostmere water frozen so slowly it set clear. It does not melt in the hand. It does not melt in a forge either, which is the difficulty.

name: Cinder-Salt
description: Scraped off the Ashen Throne, where the heat drove everything out of the stone but this. Tastes of iron. Nobody tastes it twice.

name: Star Hollow Dust
description: Collected where the sky is closest and least reliable. It settles upward if left alone, so it is never left alone.

name: Mire-Ichor
description: Pale, luminous, foul. Bled from the Brood-things of the drowned shallows. Useless alone; the basis of half the alchemy on the Drowned Coast.

name: Mire-Brood Chitin
description: Plate from a thing that grows a new one each season and abandons the old where it stood.

name: Ashen Stag Heart-Tendon
description: The Heartmarch hunters string bows with it and say an arrow loosed from one arrives before the sound does.

name: Wrath-Slag
description: The cooled residue of a Manifestation. Still faintly warm an Age later, and still, very slightly, trying to qualify whoever holds it.

name: Leviathan Baleen
description: Cut from a Primordial that was never killed, only out-waited. It filters things out of air that air was not known to contain.

name: Colossus Filament
description: Sigil-wire from the Iron Colossus's commanding core. Still carrying an order. Still trying to deliver it to a chain of command four hundred years dead.

name: Sounding-Horn of the Sunken Leviathan
description: It still holds one note. The Old Guard who took it never agreed on what the note does, only that the sea answered the one time it was sounded.

name: Haft of Gravewend
description: A farm tool from a village whose name is not written down, carried by a man whose name is not written down, who used it to kill a thing that should have killed him. The village is gone. The pitchfork is not.

name: Null-Sigil Ink
description: The medium the Sealwrights wrote closure in. It does not dry so much as decide to stop.

name: Quiet Lamp Oil
description: Drawn from a Last Watch relay lamp that has burned unattended since the fall. The Watch does not know what it burns and has stopped asking.

name: Greater Energy Draught
description: Restores 150 Energy. Brewed at the relays, for a road that does not end at dusk.

name: Grand Energy Draught
description: Restores 400 Energy. The Weir issues these to couriers who are not expected back soon.

name: Greater Stamina Draught
description: Restores 150 Stamina. The arm gives out before the will does. This is for the arm.

name: Grand Stamina Draught
description: Restores 400 Stamina. Drunk before a company commits to something it cannot walk away from.

name: Greater Healing Poultice
description: Restores 150 Health. Closes what a company opened.

name: Ancient's Draught
description: Refills your Stamina completely. Found, never sold.

name: Greater Stat Bag
description: Contains 40 unassigned skill points. Old Guard requisition, unopened since the fall.

name: Ancient's Reliquary
description: Contains 100 unassigned skill points. What the Dawnward Choir calls an answer.

name: Sigil of the Last Lamp
description: The name of a lamp that has not gone out. Speak it and the vigil resumes.

name: Sigil of the Last Lamp (Hard)
description: The name of a lamp that has not gone out. Spoken harder, it answers harder.

name: Sigil of the Last Lamp (Legendary)
description: The name of a lamp that has not gone out, and of the thing that has been circling it.

name: Sigil of the Last Lamp (Nightmare)
description: The name of a lamp that has not gone out. At this pitch, something else uses the name too.

name: Warren Teeth
description: Goblins replace them constantly and leave the old ones where they fall. A tunnel floor is half gravel and half this.

name: Brood Carapace
description: Plate off something that outgrew three of these before anyone got close enough to measure.

name: Ashen Stag Ash
description: What is left where one lay down. The Heartmarch hunters do not collect it and will not say why.

name: Deepwood Heart
description: Cut from an apex that had been growing since before the Sundering. Still warm four days out.

name: Gravesalt
description: The Watch packs it around anything it has to move twice. It works, and nobody has asked how.

name: Barrow Iron
description: Grave-goods iron, buried long enough to take on the habit. It does not rust and it does not hold an edge — the Watch considers the trade fair.

name: Amber Rot
description: The Awakening's own residue. It is warm, it is slightly wrong, and it keeps indefinitely in a sealed jar that nobody wants in their pack.

name: Glutbound Core
description: The dense part of a thing that had nearly finished becoming something else.

name: Cracked Command Sigil
description: Prised off a Wrought mid-order. It is still trying to finish the sentence.

name: Brimstone Slag
description: Cools where a Swollen thing stood too long. Emberpan is paved in it, mostly.

name: Leviathan Tooth
description: One of very many, and still the largest object most people will ever hold.

name: Kronarch's Broken Seal
description: From the muster-rolls of the army that won against nothing. Most of the names are legible.

name: Sovereign's Shed Scale
description: The Gauntlet collects them. It has never said what for and has never been asked twice.

name: Lamp-Black
description: Soot off a relay lamp, ground fine. The Watch hems its hoods with it so a courier does not shine in a doorway.

name: Sable Vein Thread
description: The Houses dye it twice and will not discuss the second dye.

name: Marsh Pitch
description: Boiled down over three days. Gravewardens seal their wades with it and their coffins too.

name: Cork-and-Iron Sole
description: Salvager's stock. Buoyant enough to float a boot and heavy enough to keep it down.

name: Resonant Brass
description: Cast to hum at one note and no other. The Choir orders it by the tone, never the weight.

name: Siege Lead
description: Backing for a breaker's visor. A Wrought does not aim, which makes shielding a guess everywhere at once.

name: Relay Draught
description: Restores 900 Energy. Issued to a courier who is not expected to stop.

name: Warhorn Draught
description: Restores 900 Stamina. Drunk by a company that has decided the thing in front of it is going down today.

name: Grand Healing Poultice
description: Restores 400 Health. Field-standard for anything the Weir calls a bad week.

name: Ancient's Mending
description: Refills your Health completely. Found, never sold.

name: Oathsworn Cache
description: Contains 65 unassigned skill points. Left by a company that did not need them after all.

name: The Devil's Tea
description: Restores 260 Energy. He offers it to everyone who comes to kill him. Several have stayed for a second cup and one is reportedly still there.

name: The Long Afternoon
description: Restores 260 Stamina. Bottled from a nap of genuinely historic proportions.

name: Perpetual Censer Resin
description: Scraped from the inside of a censer lit during the Age of Dawn. There is still some left. There has always been some left.

name: Unwalked Leather
description: Cut for slippers that were never worn outdoors. Immaculate, and faintly reproachful.

name: A Moment's Reconsideration
description: Grants 25 unassigned skill points. He suggests you think about where you put them. He is not going to elaborate and he is not going to stop looking at you.

name: Bog Cotton
description: Grows in standing water and pulls out in handfuls. Wadding, tinder, bandage — a Weir pack carries it because it is the cheapest thing that is ever useful.

name: Road Flint
description: Picked off any causeway by anyone who bothers to look down. It has started every fire the frontier has ever needed and it has never once been remarkable.

name: Rendered Tallow
description: Every relay lamp in the Watch burns it, every boot in the Weir is greased with it, and nobody has ever written a sentence about it before this one.

name: Coarse Thread
description: Spun thick enough to sew canvas and cheap enough to waste. The frontier repairs more than it replaces, and this is what it repairs with.

name: Weir Scrap
description: Rivets and strap-iron off Iron Weir issue. Enough of it reforges a piece.

name: Weir Tack
description: Bit, buckle and shoe-iron from a Weir courser's tack. They do not come off easily.

name: Marchwatch Scrap
description: Oiled wool and storm-cloth cut from Marchwatch kit, still smelling of rain.

name: Marchwatch Tack
description: Harness leather from a Marchwatch rounder, waxed against a weather that never let up.

name: Warrens Scrap
description: Soot-black leather and brass fittings out of the pits. Every piece was worn down there.

name: Warrens Tack
description: A pit pony's tack — squat brass rings and a lamp-hook, black to the core.

name: Relay Scrap
description: Cream canvas, blue piping, brass. Last Watch relay kit, taken off a relay runner.

name: Relay Tack
description: A relay charger's tack, signal-lamp bracket still on the saddle.

name: Gravewarden Scrap
description: Barrow-iron plate and pitch-sealed canvas, with a line of gravesalt in every fold.

name: Gravewarden Tack
description: Dray harness, black pitch on iron. It was made to pull weight out of the ground.

name: Drowned Scrap
description: Verdigris copper and sealed cork. It came up out of the water and is still wet.

name: Drowned Tack
description: Tack from a drowned courser: glass-beaded, copper-buckled, and it does not rust.

name: Sable Vein Scrap
description: Matte black cloth with a single gold lozenge. House work; the seam is invisible.

name: Sable Vein Tack
description: A Sable courser's tack, narrow and severe, gold at one point only.

name: Wroughtbreaker Scrap
description: Lead-grey slab iron with a cracked orange core. Siege metal, not armour.

name: Wroughtbreaker Tack
description: A destrier's barding off a siege line — heavy enough to need two hands.

name: Choir Scrap
description: Resonant brass and pale bone. Strike it and it holds a note for too long.

name: Choir Tack
description: Palfrey tack in brass and bone, cut open at the ears so the animal can hear the choir.

name: Sovereign Scrap
description: Crimson scale on antique gold, edge-plated. Regalia; it wants a throne under it.

name: Sovereign Tack
description: Wyrm tack. There is no word for what it is made of that anyone will say aloud.

name: Stoned Devil Scrap
description: Maroon and cream with aged brass, soft to the touch. Nothing about it is sharp.

name: Stoned Devil Tack
description: A goat's tack. Someone hung a small brass censer off it and it is still smoking.

name: Vanguard Scrap
description: White enamel, deep blue and gold, four-pointed star. Pano's line wore this and did not come back.

name: Vanguard Tack
description: Barding from Pano's own steed, star still bright on the chamfron.
